description: Administrative interface for managing user permissions, roles, and organizational access. Allows viewing, editing, and managing user role assignments across the organization.

pages.name: UserManagementComponent
pages.description: This page provides a centralized administrative interface for overseeing and managing all user accounts within the system. Administrators can view a comprehensive list of users, modify their assigned roles and permissions, and manage their access levels across different organizational units. This ensures proper access control and security for the entire organization.

search.description: Allows users to quickly locate specific user accounts by searching their name or email address within the system.
search.help_text: Enter a user's full name, first name, last name, or email address into the search box to filter the user list. The search is case-insensitive.

filters.name: role_filter
filters.label: Role
filters.description: Filters the user list to display only users assigned to a specific role (e.g., Admin, Standard User, Custom Role).

filters.name: organizational_unit_filter
filters.label: Organizational Unit
filters.description: Filters users based on their associated organizational unit. Includes an option to toggle 'My Org Unit Only' for quick access to local users.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble finding a user, try using the search bar with their name or email, or apply filters by role or organizational unit. To modify a user's access, click the 'Edit' button next to their entry in the list. Remember that different roles grant varying levels of access to system features. If you only want to see users from your department, use the 'My Org Unit Only' toggle.
common_tasks: Finding a user: Use the search box at the top of the page or apply filters for role and organizational unit to narrow down the list.
Changing user roles: Locate the user, click the 'Edit' button next to their name, select or deselect the desired role checkboxes, and then save your changes.
Filtering by organization: Use the 'My Org Unit Only' toggle to view users only within your assigned organizational unit, or select a specific organizational unit from the dropdown filter.
Managing access levels: Assign appropriate roles like 'Admin' for full control, 'Standard User' for general access, or custom roles for specific permissions.
Bulk management: Utilize the table's search and filter options, along with pagination, to efficiently manage large numbers of users.
troubleshooting: Problem: Cannot find a specific user in the list → Solution: Double-check the spelling in the search bar. Try using only part of their name or email. Ensure no filters are active that might be hiding the user (clear all filters and search again).

Problem: Changes to user roles are not saving → Solution: Verify you have the necessary administrative permissions to modify user roles. Ensure all required fields are correctly filled before attempting to save. Check for any error messages displayed on the screen.

Problem: The user list is too long and difficult to navigate → Solution: Make use of the search bar to find specific users quickly. Apply role or organizational unit filters to reduce the number of displayed users to a manageable size.
help_guidance.getting_started: Welcome to the User Management page! This is where you control who has access to what within the system. To get started, you'll see a list of all current users. You can use the search bar to find a specific person or the filters to narrow down by role or department. To change a user's permissions, simply click 'Edit' next to their name, adjust their roles, and save. This ensures everyone has the right level of access for their job.
